purpose: Discovery-stage manipulation check ONLY: does a competitive (relative-payoff) responder move its stag probability the opposite way and flip the deployment value of the extreme stag update, relative to a cooperative responder? No method claim is made from this cohort. Pilot roots become calibration roots afterwards; they never enter the test set.

pilot_go_criteria.competitive_q_vs_candidate7_below_incumb: mean over competitive roots of q(after 32 eps | focal p=.875) < q(after 32 | focal p=.5)
pilot_go_criteria.cooperative_q_vs_candidate7_above_incumb: mirror for cooperative roots (replicates v3 direction)
pilot_go_criteria.candidate7_deployment_sign_differs_by_ty: cooperative mean deployment delta of candidate 7 > 0 AND competitive mean is lower by at least min_type_separation_return_units
pilot_go_criteria.best_candidate_differs_by_type: argmax of mean audit label differs between the two types (incumbent admissible)

on_no_go: STOP. Do not change lambda, learning rate, horizons or candidates to force a flip. Report pilot_report.json and wait for a human decision.
compute: 4 single-thread workers, ~2 h wallclock, ~2,816 native episodes
